text:
leah: FYI planning enable of catalog v4-candidate in US/EU/APAC during change window 01:00-03:00 UTC tomorrow. Need final on staged hedge, pin exceptions, fallback ordering, and quick rollback thresholds.
marcus: +1. Suggest micro-hedge: 2% 5m -> 10% 15m -> 30% 20m -> hold 30m. Exclude pinned routes.
izumi: Recommend pin drain 20m. Fallback ladder: prod-stable -> quantized-v3 -> low-mem-fallback.
deploybot: preflight:
```
checks: [config-locked, artifacts-ok, telemetry-hooked, quant-profile-check]
result: config-locked:ok, artifacts-ok:ok, telemetry-hooked:warning (no eval-smoke in apac), quant-profile-check:ok
```
deploybot: telemetry warning must be resolved or acknowledged before approval.
dave: Telemetry can push a 25-sample smoke set by 22:00 today; if not, enable synthetic-smoke with stricter alerts.
ops-lead: Rollback thresholds: immediate rollback if error rate +0.6% absolute for 3m OR p95 +35% for 10m. Soft pause at p95 +12% for 5m to halt progression.
leah: Also add regional fallback: if APAC p95 breaches, route new allocations to EU until resolved. Pin semantics: pinned routes stay at 100% and won't receive hedge traffic.
marcus: I'll document runbook steps: who toggles enable, who executes rollback, and where to post telemetry.
dave: I'll wire a regression job every 5m posting to #model-telemetry with strict flag and a bisect helper link.
deploybot: approval requested: set enable=true for v4-candidate scope=[us,eu,apac] schedule=5177865600 (01:00 UTC tomorrow). Please acknowledge telemetry warning to proceed.
izumi: Acknowledge telemetry risk; product will monitor live evals.
ops-lead: Ops approves. I'll be on-call and have rollback playbook ready.
leah: Approved. I'll update runbook and ping #releases 15m before start. :rocket:
